records.deidentified_narrative: on [date] i was dispatched for a disturbance at 27595 ih10 w (rustico at fair oaks) involving vehicle damage. when i arrived i observed a red tow truck (trinity towing txlp t1941k) parked off to the side in the parking lot. there was a gray huyandai elantra (tx lp [identifier]) crashed into a white ford focus ([identifier]). i first spoke to claudia minge who stated, her mother luz monsalve parked her huyandai elantra in an unauthorized spot by the garage, because she was not aware she was not suppose to park there. when the driver of trinity towing had already picked the car up, monsalve climbed onto the tow truck demanding jose hernandez (employed by trinity towing) to release the car. during this event the owner of the huyandai got into her car while it was secured to [roadway] and turned it on. hernandez agreed to release the car and asked minge to exit the car so he could lower it. she complied, hernandez lowered, and released it the car, and it started to roll backwards. in an attempt to stop the car minge grabbed onto her car causing her head to get stuck between her car, and another parked car, as her vehicle crashed into the white ford focus. i asked minge if she needed ems and she refused. i looked at her head and she did not appear to have any injury marks. minge had a dealers tag displayed on her vehicle from artex auto sales and she presented me mhi catlin specialty insurance (ph [phone] policy [phone]) belonging to her employer. she stated, her boss ignacio aubone (ph [phone]) agreed to sell the car for her off his lot, and allowed her to use the dealer tx tag (20581y5), and his company insurance. minge stated she does not have insurance on the car, changed her mind, and requested to leave her boss out of the situation. i spoke to hernandez and he told me the vehicle did not have a parking permit displayed and that was why he was towing the vehicle. i attempted to contact the owner of the ford focus, but was unsuccessful. i left a card with the [case id] in the door jam. hernandez stated, he would make the property management aware of what happened. i gave both parties [case id] and returned to service. i also completed a crash report.
